name: ladder
description: A DCA ladder that cannot eat the balance: at most four adds, spaced in price and in time, a hard stop for the whole basket, and optionally a trend filter and a pause after a loss. max_adds 0 is the same design without a ladder, so the search itself says whether averaging down earns its risk.

max_adds.note: ladder adds allowed after the entry (live: 5)

ladder_multipliers.note: lots of the entry and of each add, in units; fibonacci is the live ladder

ladder_min_gap.note: an add only after price has moved this far against the last fill: USD per 0.01 lot (gold: price units; BTC: x100)

ladder_min_interval_s.note: an add only this many seconds after the last fill

rsi_oversold.note: a buy basket adds when the tier timeframe's RSI is at or below this (live 35)

rsi_overbought.note: a sell basket adds when the tier timeframe's RSI is at or above this (live 65)

stop_loss_usd_per_unit.note: the whole basket is closed at this loss, USD per unit (live: no stop)

target_usd_per_unit.note: USD of basket profit per unit that closes the basket (live 1)

target_per_lot.note: true = the target grows with every add (USD per 0.01 lot held) instead of staying at one unit's worth

trend_tf.note: entries only with this timeframe's trend; null = no filter

loss_cooldown_s.note: pause after a losing basket, seconds; 0 = the live 5 minutes

force_close_enabled.note: the live exit when the M15 slope score turns against the basket

conditions.note: without adds nothing about the ladder can matter, and a basket of one unit has the same target either way
fibonacci and linear lots are the same up to the second add (1, 2, 3)
the two RSI levels are kept symmetric: the overbought level follows the oversold one (this and the next two conditions)
